Name: Horse Women - My Little Pony
Author: KakuJoey
Description:
[u][b][center][size=4]Horse Women: A My Little Pony Friendship is Magic Mod (WIP)[/size]
(For Content Patcher)[/center][/b][/u]

Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1345]Miowee's portrait mod[/url] as a base, this mod replaces the bachelorettes and eventually other villagers with characters from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.
I currently have Fluttershy/Penny, Twilight/Maru, Pinkie/Emily and Applejack/Leah finished, but am working on others. The mod doesn't aim to largely change the original character's dialogue (except for Applejack's, due to her wildly different grammar/mannerisms), but it does change their name in (hopefully) all texts.

[u]Finished Characters
[/u]Fluttershy
Twilight
Pinkie Pie
Applejack
Rainbow Dash

[u]Planned Characters[/u]
Rarity
?????

[u]Credit goes to[/u]
-Miowee for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1345]portrait mod[/url], which I used as a base for the bachelorettes/bachelors
-Apollyon for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7063]base code[/url] I used to change dialogue and character names.

[u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Unpack "[i][b][CP] Horse Women.zip[/b][/i]"
[*]Place unpacked folder:"[i][b][CP] Horse Women[/b][/i]" into "[i][b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/b][/i]"
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[u]Support
[/u]If you find any issues with the mod (such as a name not being changed), feel free to let me know in the "Bugs" tab!

If you'd like to support [i][b]me[/b][/i], buy me a coffee at: [url=https://ko-fi.com/kakujo]https://ko-fi.com/kakujo[/url]
My mod will always be free. [b][color=#00ff00]I'm currently raising money to go to my first MLP convention at Everfree Northwest in 2023 (previously 2021, but then Covid happened again)![/color][/b] Financial support also allows me to spend more time making ponies.

-Replaced Abigail's portraits and sprites with Rainbow Dash (now including beach sprites).
-Added pinned ears to the girls whose portraits were missing them.
-Added a bit of contrast to Pinkie's muzzle.
-Edited Fluttershy's crying portrait a tiny bit.
